I wrote `component.html` in the audit folder. It's one 1280px screen inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. I haven't opened it in a browser or run `check:ui`, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Content:** it has the "Audit log" heading, the "Date range" select set to "Last 7 days", and all eight events with time, person and action, worded exactly as given.
- **Design rules:** the layout follows `DESIGN.md`. The page is white and the content column is 1120px. The select and the table rows use the sizes and borders it specifies. All colours, spacing and type sizes come from the tokens, which I inlined from `tokens.css`.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as files in this folder, so the page falls back to system fonts.
- **Additions:** I added small initials avatars next to each person, hidden from screen readers. The table also has "Time", "Person" and "Action" column headers. Neither was in your list of content.
- **Layout choice:** the screen has no primary action, so the date filter sits where the primary action would go, on the right of the title row.
